The '''Financial Division''' was a branch of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. It dealt with finance and banking. After leaving the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]], [[Riga Lanchenzoor]] joined the Financial Division and became its [[Executive Viceprex]]. Subdivisions of the Financial Division included [[Gross Revenue]], [[Revenue (Corporate Sector Authority)|Revenue]], [[Stock and Investment]], and [[Contracting and Licensing]].<ref name="HSCS" />
